verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs walk through creating a collection, adding documents and searching, all programmatically through its REST API, with no dashboard step. A first-party MCP server lets an agent build collections, index data and tune search from the conversation. An official CLI is documented, and llms.txt positions the product for AI agents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full flow; the MCP server is documented only for Typesense Cloud, not self-hosted; no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths.
